C1120.title: Brave Discloses Indirect Prompt Injection Vulnerability in Perplexity Comet
C1120.summary: On August 20, 2025, Brave disclosed an indirect prompt injection vulnerability in the Perplexity Comet browser. Researchers hid malicious instructions in a Reddit comment. When a user asked Comet to summarize the page, the agent retrieved an email address and one-time password and sent them back, enabling takeover of the Perplexity account. Brave's post-publication tests found that this attack class was not fully mitigated.
